sites.rationale: Python confirmed sequence length 260 and residue 260 = D. The topology landmarks place residues 50–260 extracellular, putting the C-terminus 211 residues from the TM boundary — well clear of the ≥3-residue constraint. Because the clip names only 'C terminal' with no residue number, and exactly one C-terminus exists on the extracellular face, the junction is unambiguously insert_after_residue = 260 (topology_derived). A ~15–23 aa HA tag appended here faces the extracellular space with no steric conflict from the TM anchor. Full-length BRICD5 with a C-terminal HA tag (pCDNA3.4-BRICD5-HA) was generated by Quintara Bio and reported in PMC13570295. No residue number is stated; the clip says only 'C terminal'. BRICD5 is a type II single-pass transmembrane protein (intracellular 1–28, TM 29–49, extracellular 50–260), so the C-terminus (residue 260, D) is the sole extracellular terminus and the only possible location for this tag.

sources.claim: The pCDNA3.4-CD45AP-HA (C terminal), pCDNA3.4-BRICD5-HA (C terminal), and pCDNA3-Flag-DCBLD2-HA (N terminal Flag, C terminal -HA) plasmids were generated by Quintara Bio.

literature_notes: Only one ledger line (L1) is provided. It supports a single C-terminal HA tag on full-length BRICD5. No residue number is stated, but the type II topology leaves exactly one extracellular terminus (residue 260). The construct was only reported as 'generated'; no surface-expression, trafficking, or functional data are cited, so validation_level is not_measured and confidence is medium rather than high. No internal extracellular loop insertions are supported by the ledger. No intracellular or function-abrogating positions are mentioned.
